query: 平均工资超过 15000 的部门有哪些？

outcome.sql: SELECT "d"."dept_name" AS "dept_name", ROUND(AVG("e"."salary"), 2) AS "avg_salary" FROM "public"."emp" "e" INNER JOIN "public"."dept" "d" ON "e"."dept_id" = "d"."dept_id" GROUP BY "d"."dept_name" HAVING AVG("e"."salary") > 15000 ORDER BY "avg_salary" DESC, "dept_name" ASC LIMIT 40
